Test_MPPT.description: Test MPPT with round numbers: 10 A output cap, 0.9 efficiency. max_output_voltage 36 V sits within MPPT_BATTERY_VOLTAGE_BUFFER (15 V) of both a 1S (24 V) and a 2S (48 V) Test_Battery at SOC 0.5, so no voltage-mismatch error is raised for either topology.

Test_Panel.description: 100 W at 20 V, so one panel string sources exactly 5 A.

Test_Battery.description: 24 V nominal per cell. Battery_Array prefers min/max interpolation, so at current_soc 0.5 the per-cell voltage is exactly 24.0 V.

Test_Battery_Low_Discharge.description: Test_Battery with a 5 A discharge cap, used to force over-discharge restriction.

Test_Battery_Low_Charge.description: Test_Battery with a 2 A charge cap, used to force the load balancer to absorb excess charge current.

Test_Load_Linear.description: No motor physics constants, so Load falls back to the linear model: power = throttle x total_power.

Test_Load_BLDC.description: BLDC physics model. propeller_kp is auto-derived so rated current (500 W / 24 V = 20.83 A) is reached at full throttle.
